summary: postinstall fetches and executes a binary from a hardcoded bare-IP endpoint with TLS verification disabled
details: The postinstall lifecycle script downloads a tarball from the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint https://218.90.133.98:4443/onecode_tgz using https.get with rejectUnauthorized:false (certificate validation disabled), extracts it via tar, chmods the extracted file 0755, and hardlinks it as the package's CLI. No hash or signature verification is performed on the fetched bytes, and the source is neither the npm registry nor a domain matching the package publisher. Any party controlling that IP address, or any on-path attacker, can serve arbitrary executable content that runs on the installer's machine as a consequence of npm install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
